title: carol joins, alice hits, bob misses, optimized

timeline.label: Carol joins the game. The stack holds `len`, the length of her name. `name` isn't copied anywhere. The compiler's data points straight at the name's bytes in the call data. Memory holds their offset and length.
Carol's name is now in her record in storage. One slot holds its length and two slots hold its bytes.
Carol's join is done. `playerList` now holds her address as its third item.
Alice plays. The code is now in `play()`. `player` has no location yet because nothing has been copied from storage.
The code has copied Alice's record from storage into memory. `player` now lives there.
`play()` has counted this play and called `_turn` with its copy of the record. The roll gives a hit, and `hit` now has a location.

The optimizer has inlined `_applyCombo` into `_turn`. Its code runs right here with no real call. The compiler's data still marks where the call begins, so only `_applyCombo`'s own variables are listed. `combo` is now 3, and `mult` has no location yet.
`mult = combo` doesn't copy anything. The compiler's data points `mult` at the same memory word as `combo`. `combo` uses the last 4 bytes of the word. `mult` has a wider type and uses the last 8.
Back in `_turn`. `_applyCombo`'s variables are gone. `gained` holds the result that `_applyCombo` returned and now has a location in memory.
Alice's record is back in storage, with score 60 and combo 3. `_turn` has also added to `totalScore` and `totalHits`.
Bob plays for the second time. The code is now in `play()`. `player` has no location yet.
The code has copied Bob's record into memory. His combo is 1 from his first play.
The roll gives a miss, so `_turn` returns early through `_resetCombo`. The optimizer has inlined `_resetCombo`, and its code is about to set `player.combo` to 0.
Back in `play()`. `_turn` has returned Bob's record with combo 0. So far only the copy in memory has changed.
Bob's record is back in storage, with combo 0 and plays 2. His score and best combo stay the same, and a miss changes neither `totalScore` nor `totalHits`.
